from decimal import Decimal, localcontext

_DECIMAL_PRECISION = 28

def execute(inputs):
    with localcontext() as decimal_context:
        decimal_context.prec = _DECIMAL_PRECISION
        operating_cash_flow = Decimal(str(inputs["operating_cash_flow"]))
        capital_expenditure = Decimal(str(inputs["capital_expenditure"]))
        revenue = Decimal(str(inputs["revenue"]))
        if revenue == Decimal("0"):
            raise ValueError("revenue_non_zero")
        signed_free_cash_flow = (operating_cash_flow + capital_expenditure)
        result = (signed_free_cash_flow / revenue)
        if not result.is_finite():
            raise ValueError("result_is_finite")
        return {"value": str(result), "unit": "RATIO"}
